note: Independent CURRENT-Core source rejudgment against RFC1661 Section5.8: Echo-Request and Echo-Reply may only be sent in LCP Opened. Complete TestRFC1661KeepaliveEchoOnlyInOpened drives actual run through accepted authentication to an emitted Echo, then peer renegotiation; after three restart intervals its next packet must be the configured request retransmission, never a stale ticker Echo. TestRFC1661EchoReplyInOpened requires the actual reply Identifier/Magic; TestRFC1661NoEchoOutsideOpened uses the same valid peer Magic in ReqSent/AckSent/AckRcvd/Stopped and forbids both Echo Codes, isolating state from Magic rejection. Complete client TestClientLCPEchoBeforeOpenDiscarded injects valid Echo Requests before completion and in AckRcvd, retaining exactly the original Configure-Request before valid final peer configuration. Read LCPDoTransition/performAction plus run ticker state transition and client negotiateLCP Echo discard: only Opened permits server emission and leaving Opened stops old ticker channels. This is assertion/producer source judgment; no new runtime/native evidence inferred.
